title: 2017 New York Times article as a new project using the UFO subject
summary: Greg Bishop tells of 2017 New York Times article as a new project using the UFO subject, about 2017 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: when I first saw that article in 2017, the New York Times article, the Kane Blumenthal thing.

plain: Greg Bishop, a researcher and writer on UFOs, talks about a 2017 New York Times article by journalists Leslie Kean and Ralph Blumenthal that featured a former Pentagon official named Lou Elizondo. Bishop says that when he first read it, he saw it as the start of a new project that was using the UFO subject for some purpose. If he is right, the public wave of UFO news since then would be, at least partly, something someone set in motion on purpose.
